name: The Interview of Charity Kase
source:
Your name is Detective Denzel Poole, you've been hired by a shifty news reporter to interview a well known serial killer about their past, uncover hidden facts, mystery and who knows... maybe the truth would of been there all along!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250803132109/https://crustycatman.itch.io/the-interview-of-charity-kase]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是侦探丹泽尔·普尔，受雇于一名形迹可疑的新闻记者，前去采访一位声名狼藉的连环杀手，探寻其过往经历，挖掘隐藏的事实与谜团——谁知道呢……说不定真相从一开始就近在眼前！

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250803132109/https://crustycatman.itch.io/the-interview-of-charity-kase]itch.io[/url]]
